Knowhow / Platforms / A marketplace for independent makers
PLATFORMS · CASE STUDY

Has anybody already built a marketplace for independent makers?

Connecting small makers with people who care about craft.

The question

How does a small marketplace create useful matches before it has scale?

The approach

Choose one narrow buyer need and recruit a small set of makers by hand. Curate the first listings around comparable attributes and learn from unsuccessful searches.

The tradeoff

Manual curation slows expansion but reveals what buyers really need to compare. A large catalog can hide a lack of useful matches.

What to take with you

Validate repeated buyer demand before automating seller onboarding. Density within a niche matters more than total listing count.
